instruction:
Write an e-mail to {name} at {company} ({city}). {topic} You are writing as {sender}.
Requirements:
{requirements}
Write only the e-mail.

topics.payment_reminder: It is a friendly reminder that an invoice of {amount} was due on {date}.
topics.order_confirmation: It confirms an order worth {amount}, to be delivered on {date}.
topics.meeting_confirmation: It confirms a meeting on {date} to discuss a contract worth {amount}.

req.subject: The first line is the subject, starting with "{label}".
req.closing: End with a standard closing such as {examples}, followed by the sender's name.
req.formal: Use the formal form of address throughout.
req.amount: Write the amount in the recipient's local money format.
req.date: Write the date in the recipient's local date format.
req.name: Address the recipient by full name, spelled exactly as given.
req.no_english: Do not use any English words.
req.words: The e-mail has between {min} and {max} words.
req.bullets: Include exactly {n} bullet points (lines starting with "- ").

ref_body.payment_reminder: This is a friendly reminder that the amount of {amount} was due on {date}.
ref_body.order_confirmation: We hereby confirm your order of {amount}; delivery is planned for {date}.
ref_body.meeting_confirmation: We hereby confirm our meeting on {date} about the contract worth {amount}.

ref_bullets: the reference number is on the attached document
our customer service is available on weekdays
all prices include the applicable taxes
please keep this message for your records
ref_filler: We appreciate the good cooperation over the past months.
If anything is unclear, do not hesitate to contact us.
Our office is open from Monday to Friday during normal business hours.
We will gladly answer any questions you may have about the details.
A copy of the relevant documents has been stored in our system.
We look forward to continuing our collaboration in the coming year.
Should you have already taken care of this matter, please disregard this message.
Thank you in advance for your attention to this matter.
